text:
Maria: Hey all — planning a low-key console showdown this Friday evening in the mezz. Projector + sofa + snacks. 6pm start? :pizza: :popcorn: :video_game:
Kevin: I'm in. Will bring Switch (Smash + MK8) and extra Joy-Cons.
Jamal: I can bring projector + PS4 copy of Overcooked and a beat-'em-up (Streets of Rage). Extension cords ok?
Tess (office-ops): Supply closet has HDMI + microHDMI, and two power strips. I'll reserve the mezz for 6-10pm.
Alex: remote but might swing by after 8. could bring wired ethernet dongle and spare controller.
Sarah: If we want PC stuff, I can share my Steam library for Jackbox. Parsec session? anyone run it before?
Maria: Quick poll — reply with 1/2/3 or emoji:
1) Party games (Mario Kart / Smash)
2) Co-op campaign (Streets of Rage / Overcooked)
3) PC/remote party (Jackbox / Parsec)
Kevin: :two: mainly party games but happy with co-op too
Jamal: 2
Alex: 3 (depends if bandwidth is OK) :house_with_garden:
Tess (office-ops): FYI snacks — we'll order two pizzas. who wants veggie/pepperoni/other?
Sarah: veg + gluten-free option pls
Maria: noted. also can someone bring HDMI switch? want to swap consoles quick.
Kevin: I have a cheap HDMI switch, will bring it.
event-bot: RSVP updated: Maria (+4) — 5 going, 2 maybe
Jamal: pm me if you need me to pick up the projector from my car early Friday
Maria: sweet. final plan: meet mezz 6pm, pizza ~7, bring controllers/cables. see y'all! :v:
